tasks.label: Build Debug
args: & { $v = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $m = & $v -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe; if ($m) { & $m 'RM.App.sln' '/t:Build' '/p:Configuration=Debug' '/v:minimal' } else { Write-Error 'MSBuild не найден' } }
